notes: PAP reference G55/0391. Whole two-room apartment in Caen's 2017 ISEO residence, on the first floor with lift and reduced-mobility access. The complete advert describes an 18 m2 living room opening onto a terrace, semi-equipped kitchen, nearly 11 m2 bedroom, Italian-style shower room with WC, hallway and storage, plus a private outdoor parking space. It states gas heating and hot water, double glazing, roller shutters, ventilation, no work required, and a healthy 36-lot coproperty with no ongoing procedure. The dwelling is explicitly sold free of all occupation and available quickly. DPE C and GES C are stated from an assessment dated 11 September 2026. PAP exposed 7 property photos and a publication date of 30 September 2026.
